summary: Iteration 115: Users yesterday analytics, template lists export/import (backup/restore), template list search across names+lines, and zone follow-ups. Backend 20/21 pytest pass (new file test_it115_yesterday_backup_zone.py). Frontend all tested flows pass: Users yesterday tile and dialog (seeded activity row shown, 9:03 AM FREE), Users today dialog still works; Export all lists downloads my-boat-prep-template-lists-2026-11-06.json with toast '19 template lists exported'; invalid JSON gives error toast; restore preview groups add/unchanged/skip correctly, Cancel changes nothing, Confirm 'Restore 1 list' gives toast '1 template list restored', the list reloads (19->20) and the new list keeps its backup list_id; search 'tomato' -> 'Showing 2 of 19 lists' with hit lines, marks, '+ 3 more matching lines'; no-match state works; Batch area form for Galley zone shows batch-area-zone-banner (label Galley), toggle expands plan + 2 photos. All test data cleaned up: admin lists exactly match the original export (19 lists, identical items/desc/private/name), no leavingDock override created, pro boat zone maps back to Full interior/Galley/Galley 2, seeded user_activity and TEST user/session deleted.

minor.issue: A custom list in the backup with a blank or whitespace-only name (e.g. '   ') gets action 'add' and would be inserted as a nameless template list. BackupList.name has no min_length and _plan doesn't check for an empty name. Fix: skip with reason 'has no name' (or add min_length=1 after strip).

Built-in masters are only exported if an admin-edited doc exists in list_templates. Right now none exist, so the backup holds 0 built-ins. That's probably fine because unedited built-ins come from the code defaults, but it means 'export all lists' only covers custom lists plus edited masters. Worth stating in the UI or exporting the defaults too.
The duplicate check for built-in entries goes by name, not list_id. Two entries with the same list_id but different names would both be applied, and the last one wins. Edge case.

issues: The highlighted <mark> has a visible gap or padding before the rest of the word ('Tomato es', 'tomato es'), so words look split. Remove horizontal padding or margin on the mark in Highlight.
The 2-column grid puts Users yesterday under Total users rather than beside Users today. It's still readable, but consider ordering the tiles so Users today and Users yesterday share a row.

action_items: Skip backup lists with blank or whitespace names in template_backup._plan (reason e.g. 'has no name')
Optional: remove mark padding in the Highlight component so highlighted words don't look split
Optional: say clearly whether unedited built-in masters are included in Export all lists
critical_code_review_comments: admin_analytics.users_between: logic is correct for hour buckets that straddle the start or end boundary (tested a straddle at the start). The ISO string comparisons hold because all values are UTC isoformat with +00:00.
auth.mark_seen: the user_activity upsert only runs when last_seen is more than 5 minutes old, which matches the design. The TTL index on expires (a datetime) is set up correctly in create_indexes.
template_backup._apply overwrite always writes updated_by even when only description/private change (fine). _keep_version runs before overwrites, which is good for undo.

Template import validates the whole payload with Pydantic. One bad list (e.g. >300 items or a label over the limit) rejects the whole file with 422 instead of skipping that list. Acceptable but harsher than the skip semantics.
seed_data_creation: Temporary user_activity docs (hour 'TEST_*'), a TEST_act_* user + session, TEST_ template lists and TEST zone maps. All were removed by id and verified afterwards. The original admin export is saved at /tmp/orig_export.json.
